title: Budget regression test for all element × backend combos
objective: Phase 9 acceptance: run the budget counter on every (element type × constitutive model × backend) combination and assert none exceeds the JIT budget. No performance regression vs the tier-only path measured in wall-clock emission time.

plan_assets.asset_description: B8b exit criterion — budget passes for all element types with named families.

scope: Parametrise the budget regression test over every supported (element, material, backend) triple.
Run the full emission pipeline and assert every contraction plan has `over_budget == False`.
Measure emission time: family-based emission must be within 1.2x of tier-only emission (no hard regression).
Add the regression test to CI's fast tier.
implementation_steps: Build a parametrised test that enumerates all triples.
For each triple, run the compile step and check the budget counter.
Time the emission and compare against a checked-in baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Every (element × material × backend) triple passes budget.
Family-based emission time within 1.2x of tier-only baseline.
CI fast tier runs the regression on every commit.

cases: Budget regression for all (element x material x backend) triples
Emission-time sanity check: family path within 1.2x of tier-only baseline (slow)

risks: Emission-time baselines drift with unrelated codegen changes. Mitigation: use a lenient 1.2x tolerance and refresh the baseline yearly.
completion_notes: 16 realisable (element × formulation × material × backend) triples identified on HEX8 (TL + UL × 4 material/backend combos that exist today). 80 skips on TET4/TET10/HEX20 (Plan B §B5.1-5.3) and per-backend material limits (MFEM SVK-only, Taichi no Perzyna).
Test 1 (fast, regression): 32 active parametrized cases — 16 budget asserts `plan.tier in {1, 2}` + 16 emission calls. All pass (no Tier 3 restructuring needed for any triple).

Test 2 (slow, regression): N=5 trials per triple, median-based ratio of family-ON vs legacy emission. All 16 ratios within 1.2× tolerance. Range 0.9009 (svk-TL-taichi) to 1.0761 (lemaitre-UL-moose). Median ~0.99.
Env-var toggling via mock.patch.dict(os.environ, ...) per trial; family_emitters_enabled() reads on each call with no module-level caching, so toggling is effective per trial.

Golden baseline at packages/mechdsl-core/tests/golden/template_family_emission_baseline.json with generated_at/ratio_tolerance/trials/note metadata. Standalone regen script at packages/mechdsl-core/tests/tools/regen_p9_3_baseline.py.
Gate B low findings (not fixed): unused monkeypatch fixture parameter on test 2 (cosmetic), bare except on golden read. Accepted as low-priority cosmetic issues.
Fast suite: 1307 passed, 81 skipped, 1 failed (only pre-existing P9-1 spec-gap test — unchanged).
